title: Content addressing: sites' directory CIDs and CARs
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/site-directory-vectors.mjs, run outside the workspace: every directory CID from Kubo 0.36.0 (`ipfs add --recursive --hidden --cid-version=1 --raw-leaves --chunker=size-1048576` with Import.UnixFSFileMaxLinks 1024; the release tarball's sha512 checked) and from ipfs-unixfs-importer 17.1.1 (wrapWithDirectory), and every CAR from Kubo's `ipfs dag export`, matched by @ipld/car 5.4.7 writing the JavaScript blocks in depth-first pre-order; any disagreement is refused. packages/crypto/scripts/release-record-vectors.py rebuilds every root and CID from the spec alone
object: SHA-256(label ‖ u32be(i)) for i = 0, 1, … concatenated and cut to `length` bytes
